callouts.heading: Callouts · {count}
callouts.insert.empty: The callout list is empty. Add callouts on the “Callouts” tab of the settings.
callouts.insert.no-note: There's nowhere to insert a callout: open a note.
callouts.intro: A callout is a quote whose first line is written like this: {example}. Obsidian draws it as a card, and so does ZeroNote. The title is part of the note's text: insertion writes it, and Obsidian will see it. A type that isn't in the list is drawn as {note}.
callouts.problems: Not everything in callouts.toml was applied; the rest works:

callouts.remove.title: Delete the callout?
callouts.title: Title
callouts.title.note: Insertion writes it after the type. Empty — just the type.
callouts.type.note: How it's written in a note: {code}. No spaces.
clipboard.rich.large: The file is open in the simplified mode — it isn't copied with formatting
clipboard.rich.no-text: Only text can be copied with formatting — a note or code
clipboard.rich.whole: The whole file was copied with formatting
code.copy.lost: Couldn't find the block under the label
code.unknown: This language isn't in the set — the block stays uncolored
conflict.question.command:
{chord} is “{what}” now.

Assigning a new command here takes the hotkey away from it: there'll be nothing to press, but it stays in the palette and the menu.
conflict.question.editor:
{chord} is “{what}” in the text editor now.

This hotkey isn't in the command list: the editor brings it. Taking it removes this action from the editor.
conflict.question.webview:
{chord} is “{what}” now, done by the webview itself.

Taking this hotkey switches it off entirely — including in input fields.
copy.diagram.failed: diagram {index} wasn't copied as an image: {reason}
diagram.too-long: The diagram isn't drawn: it's longer than {limit} characters, and the window would take seconds to draw it.
download.stall: {what} for {quiet}. If the network doesn't come back, the download stops in {left}.
download.waiting: Waiting for an answer for {elapsed} — no longer than {limit}.
drafts.failed: Drafts weren't saved: {error}. Changes are only in memory for now — retrying in two seconds.
drop.closed: The note was closed while the files were copying: there's nowhere to put the links
drop.unsaved: Save the note first: files dropped into it need its folder
encoding.reread.text: The buffer has unsaved changes. Rereading takes the bytes from disk, and the changes will be lost.
encoding.reread.title: Reread the file in another encoding?
entries.delete.file.text:
“{name}” will go to the Recycle Bin.

You can restore it from there.
entries.delete.folder.text:
“{name}” and everything inside it will go to the Recycle Bin.

You can restore it from there.
entries.links.title: Update links?
eol.mixed.text:
“{file}” has line endings of several kinds. It can no longer be saved unchanged: inside the editor all line endings are the same.

Choose which kind to convert the whole file to.
eol.mixed.title: The file has mixed line endings
export.binary: Images and PDFs are shared as the file itself — a page around them adds nothing
export.large: The file is open in the simplified mode — it isn't exported
external.changed.text:
Another program changed “{file}”, and the editor has unsaved changes.

Which to keep?
external.changed.title: File changed outside
external.overwrite.text:
Another program changed “{file}” after the editor read it.

Saving will overwrite those changes.
external.overwrite.title: File changed on disk
external.removed.text:
“{file}” is no longer on disk: deleted, renamed or unavailable.

The contents are still safe in the editor.
external.removed.title: File is gone
files.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
fonts.note: Empty — from the theme. Size from {min} to {max} pixels.

image-paste.closed: The image was saved, but the note is already closed: {link}
image-paste.not-markdown: An image can only be pasted into a markdown note
image-paste.unreadable: The image in the clipboard can't be read
image-paste.unsaved: Save the note first: the image needs a folder to go into
image.broken: the file didn't open as an image: it's damaged or not an image at all

indent.source.manual: Chosen by hand for this tab
indent.source.settings: From settings: the file has no indentation

keys.reset-all.title: Reset all hotkeys

l10n.unknown: language “{code}” is neither built in nor in the l10n folder — chosen automatically
link.dangling: There's no note with this name. Ctrl+click creates it next to this one.
menu.delete.hint: ZeroNote never deletes past the Recycle Bin
menu.open-to-side.narrow: The pane is too narrow to split in two
menu.refresh.hint: Reread the folder's contents from disk
menu.remove-root.hint: Remove from the workspace. The files on disk stay where they are.

menu.reveal.no-file: The file isn't on disk yet
menu.save.no-file: This tab has no file: there is nothing to save

replace.lossy:
Can't be read in their encoding without losses, so they aren't touched:
{list}
replace.nothing.blocked: Everything found is in files with unsaved changes — save them and try again
replace.nothing.lossy: Everything found is in files that can't be read without losses
replace.overflow: Too many matches: {total} found, and the search isn't finished. A list that long can't be reviewed, and replacing without review isn't what we do. Narrow the query or turn on “Match whole word”.
replace.title: Replace “{query}” with “{replacement}”?
replace.undo.all-blocked: The replace can't be undone now: all its files are open with unsaved changes. Save or close them and undo again.

{list}

replace.undo.nothing: Nothing to undo: there have been no project replaces in this session.

{problems}

search.project.found.limited.one: {count} file found — showing the first ones

settings.about.license: Free software under the MIT license.
settings.attachments.beside: In a folder next to the note
settings.attachments.name: Attachment folder name
settings.attachments.name.beside: A folder next to each note; created if it isn't there.
settings.attachments.name.folder: A path from the project root; created if it isn't there.
settings.attachments.note: Where an image pasted into a note from the clipboard goes. The file is named as in Obsidian: Pasted image and the time. For a note outside projects — always next to it.
settings.auto-close.note: In prose — markdown and plain text — quotes aren't closed even with this on: there they don't come in pairs.
settings.autosave.note: Write edits to the file two seconds after the last one and when the window loses focus. Drafts always work and don't depend on this.
settings.daily-folder.note: Where “Today's daily note” goes. A path inside the notes folder; empty — right in it. An absolute path means that folder itself, wherever it is.
settings.daily-template.note: The file a new note starts from. {{date}}, {{time}} and {{title}} are filled in. Empty — a heading and an empty line. A note already written is never rewritten by the template.
settings.defaults.note: “Open in ZeroNote” is already in Explorer. Windows assigns the default app for a file type itself — by your choice in the system settings.
settings.footer: Everything in this window is also in the file. The file can be edited by hand and kept in git — changes are picked up on the fly.
settings.indent-width.note: How many spaces make an indent, or how many columns a tab is drawn with.
settings.indent.note: Only for files without indentation: in the rest it's detected from the content and shown in the status bar.
settings.invisibles.note: Spaces as dots, tabs as arrows, line breaks as a pilcrow.
settings.language.note: Each language is named in itself. Changes after a restart. Your own translation is a file in the translations folder, below.
settings.language.restart.note: {language} after a restart. Nothing unsaved is lost: tabs and drafts come back as they were.
settings.line-numbers.note: “Only in code” hides numbers in markdown notes: there a line number tells you nothing. Bookmarks and folding stay in place.
settings.link-suggest.note: A list of the project's notes after two brackets in markdown. ZeroNote doesn't do code completion.
settings.live-preview.note: Markup characters are hidden but work: `**bold**` shows as bold. The line under the cursor is always shown as source, so you can edit markup without turning preview off.
settings.note-title.note: As a title above the text of a note with preview, as in Obsidian. Editing the title renames the file — with its links, as in the tree.
settings.problems: Not everything in settings.toml was applied; the rest works:
settings.readable.note: A note's text stands as a column in the middle of the window and wraps at its edge. Markdown only: in code, line length is part of the meaning.
settings.subtitle.general: Language · Editor · Notes · Settings file · About
settings.subtitle.toolbar: Buttons · Visibility · Size · the [toolbar] section of settings.toml
settings.templates.note: Where “Insert template” and “New note from template” take their list from. A path inside the notes folder; empty — no templates. {{date}}, {{time}} and {{title}} are filled in; templates run no code.
settings.title: Settings
settings.vault.note: A home for notes next to your projects: the Notes panel shows its tree even when all folders are closed. Search, [[links]] and tags work in it as in a project. Empty — data/notes in the app's data folder. Your Obsidian vault can be used: ZeroNote adds nothing to it and never touches .obsidian.
settings.wrap.note: Also switched in the status bar, next to the encoding.
sidebar.backlinks.unsaved: The file isn't saved to disk yet
sidebar.bookmarks.empty: No bookmarks. {key} sets or clears one on the cursor line.
sidebar.files.empty.hint: Ctrl+Shift+O opens a folder as a project
sidebar.files.link: {path} — a link; ZeroNote doesn't go inside
sidebar.files.obsidian: Obsidian vault: import its settings into zeronote.toml
sidebar.files.remove: Remove the folder from the workspace
sidebar.notes.new.hint: New note in the notes folder
sidebar.tags.filter.label: Filter tags
status.cursors.hint: Escape returns to a single cursor
status.encoding.bom.hint: Add or remove the mark at the start of the file.
status.encoding.bom.none: This encoding has no byte order mark.
status.encoding.convert.hint: Keep the text, change the encoding it is saved in. The file changes when saved.
status.encoding.hint.uncertain: The encoding was guessed and may be wrong. Click to change.
status.encoding.reinterpret.hint: Reread the same bytes in this encoding. Fixes garbled text; the file doesn't change.
status.encoding.reinterpret.no-file: This buffer has no file: there is nothing to reread.
status.eol.hint.mixed: The file has mixed line endings. Saving will offer to make them the same.
status.image.scale.hint: Zoom. Clicking the image switches between “fit” and actual size; Ctrl with the mouse wheel changes it in steps.
status.indent.hint: {source}. Changing it affects only how new indentation is typed; what is already in the file stays as it is.
status.index.hint: Indexing the project. Search already works but doesn't find everything yet.
status.language.auto.hint: Detect the language from the extension. Unknown ones are plain text.
status.language.hint.auto: Highlighting language detected from the file name — click to change
status.language.hint.manual: Highlighting language chosen by hand — click to change
status.lossy.hint: Reading met bytes that aren't valid in this encoding. Saving will change the file.
status.position.hint: Line {line} of {lines}, column {column}. Click to go to a line.
status.position.hint.key: Line {line} of {lines}, column {column}. Click to go to a line ({key}).
status.preview.hint.off: Showing the source with markup characters — click to turn on live preview
status.preview.hint.on: Markup characters are hidden; the line under the cursor is always source. Click to show markup
status.scale.fit.image.hint: Shrink to fit the window. A small image isn't enlarged.
status.scale.fit.pdf.hint: Stretch the page to the full width of the view.
status.words.count.hint: The file is over a megabyte: words are counted on click so typing isn't held up
status.words.properties: Properties at the top of the note aren't counted.
status.wrap.hint.off: Long lines don't wrap — click to turn on
status.wrap.hint.on: Long lines wrap at the window width — click to turn off
status.wrap.hint.readable: Wrapping comes from markdown's readable width. Clicking changes the general setting for other files
templates.new.prompt: Note name in the folder “{folder}”. The .md extension is added automatically.
templates.no-note: There's nowhere to insert a template: open a note.
templates.none: The templates folder isn't set or is empty. Set it in settings: “Templates folder”.
theme-editor.locked: A built-in theme lives inside the app and can't be edited. Make your own based on it: the copy becomes current right away and opens here for editing.
theme-editor.not-color: “{value}” isn't a color. Use #rrggbb, rgba(…) or a {palette.key} reference. The theme file is unchanged.
theme-editor.not-understood: The styling won't understand “{value}”. The theme file is unchanged.
theme-editor.pick.token: Pick a color — the color itself will be written instead of the palette reference
theme-editor.readable: Readability: text, accent and highlighting pass the same thresholds as the built-in themes.
theme-editor.reset.palette: Remove from the file: the value will come from the built-in theme
theme-editor.reset.token: Remove from the file: the default comes back
theme-editor.sections.note: Any styling token by name. Role colors refer to the palette — the entry {example} takes the color from there and changes with it.
theme-editor.title: Theme editor — {theme}
theme.finding.distance: {what} and {other} are almost the same color: difference {value}, needs {need}
theme.finding.unchecked: {what}: the color isn't given as #rrggbb — readability can't be computed
theme.note.fonts: the choice in Fonts above overrides the theme
theme.note.toolbar-size: the step is chosen on the Toolbar tab
toolbar.callout.missing: The callout is not in the list
toolbar.callout.removed: {item} — the type was removed from the callout list, the button isn't shown
toolbar.empty: The toolbar is empty — add buttons from the list below.
toolbar.path.note: trimmed on the left: the file name is always visible
toolbar.show.note: A button with nothing to do in this tab isn't shown: there's no markup over code, no editing over an image.
toolbar.spacer.note: everything after it moves to the right
toolbar.width.note: Above the column — the buttons stand above the note text, not in the left corner. Works only when readable line length is on.
translation.card.note: You can translate the window into your language yourself: a translation file in this folder, chosen in “Interface language”. Whatever the file lacks is shown in English.
translation.create.text: The language code, as in Windows: de, uk, pt-BR. A file with the string table will appear — translate the values on the right, leave the keys on the left as they are.
translation.create.title: New translation
updates.checking.text: Asking GitHub whether a new version is out.

updates.found.how: The app will download the update, close, install it and open again.
updates.installer.failed.advice: Nothing was installed. You can download the installer from the releases page: github.com/Mark-Karte/ZeroNote/releases
updates.installing.text: When everything is downloaded, the window closes, the installer shows its progress, and ZeroNote opens again. You can cancel while the download is running.
updates.installing.title: Updating to {version}
updates.launching: The signature matches. Starting the installer — the window is about to close.
updates.signature.failed: The update failed the signature check
updates.signature.failed.advice: The package is signed with a key that isn't ours or was damaged on the way. Nothing was installed.

welcome.recent.none: Files you open will appear here.
